On the AIME2025 benchmark, **Adapted Parallel-RL reaches 59.0%** and **Single-Task RL reaches 57.1%** (Table 4, page 7).

- The superscript on the Adapted Parallel-RL result (+1.9) confirms it is 1.9 points above the single-task baseline (page 7).
- Table 4 labels this setting "Baselines (Full Parameter GRPO)" for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B (page 7). Section 5.2 says the 1.5B and 7B models were trained with full parameters and GRPO (page 7).
- For context, the 7B Base Model scores 49.2% on AIME2025 (page 7). AIME2025 is reported as avg@16, the average accuracy over 16 test runs (page 13).
